references.text: The contrast between Pharaoh appointing Joseph and Joseph's claim that God has done it underscores God's sovereignty over national powers.
A parallel in the structure 'go up/down and do not be afraid,' highlighting how God leads His people through fearless movements at various historical moments.
God's confirmation to Jacob (Gen 46:3) directly responds to Joseph's invitation (Gen 45:9), showing that the journey to Egypt is part of God's plan of salvation.
The verses are direct parts of the same dialogue; Gen 45:18 expands on the invitation in Gen 45:9 with concrete promises of provision.
